basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 16H at the Millennium Tower, a luxurious 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom home overlooking the lush canopy of Salesforce Park. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame serene views of treetops and cityscape, creating a peaceful urban retreat. This bright and spacious unit features high-end finishes, an open-concept living area, and a sleek kitchen with top-tier appliances. Enjoy world-class amenities including a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, indoor pool,lounge, and private dining. Located in the heart of San Francisco with easy access to shops, dining, and transit. Some images have been virtually staged to illustrate the property's potential. Actual features and  layout may differ.
